description: PROPOSAL ONLY (#74). Each fixture names the definition of collections.schema.json it is checked against and whether it should be accepted; answers with a page are also held to the page rules check.py states, and answers with a Level 1 view to Level 1's view schema. level1 says whether Level 1's own published schemas must accept (true) or refuse (false) the same value. check.py runs them, and the scenarios.
scenario_steps: Scenarios are given/when/expect steps for #77's and #78's tests, at the test-kit seam and on the actual Host. given sets up a session or the user's immediate state; when is a user action, an answer arriving or an explicit call; expect is what the Host shows, sends or drops. A scenario's manifest says which declarations it runs under; answers and events under a Level 1 manifest are checked against Level 1's schemas, the rest against the draft. answer_illustrative holds members of other tickets (#81 Progress, #70's illustrative start_task) and is not checked. decided_choice names the product choice of design.md section 12, decided by the user on 2026-10-03, that a step or scenario follows.
